title: Cute but not going to last long
text: Cute but not going to last long. This is a nice simple bath mat. It seems to stay in place well when there is pressure on the top, and it's soft. It was folded up in transit and that did leave crease marks that took several weeks to coax out.  I like the color, it's bright. I've had it on my bathroom floor in the guest bath (rarely used) for a few weeks, and noticed it's already starting to fall apart on the top.  This may be from my cat thinking it's fun to play with, but my other bath mat has last 2 years with such cat with no noticeable damage (though I know he plays with it as well).  Will likely have to replace it in a few months or sooner, and won't be replacing with the same product as I prefer things to last a little longer.
